data.title: Contribution notice for voluntary health insurance from 1 June 2026
data.summary: Allgemeine Musterkasse sets your voluntary health and long-term care insurance contributions at €530.85 per month from 1 June 2026. The amount is collected by direct debit on the 15th of the following month.
data.explanation: Your health insurer has confirmed your contributions as a voluntary member: €412.65 for health insurance and €118.20 for long-term care insurance, €530.85 in total per month. They are collected automatically by direct debit, so make sure your account has enough money. If you think the amount is wrong, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the insurer. The app shows until when. Keep the notice, because contributions may matter for your tax return.
data.tax_note: Health and long-term care insurance contributions can be deducted as special expenses (Sonderausgaben) in your tax return.

items.title: Monthly health insurance contribution
items.action: Make sure your account has enough funds for the direct debit of €530.85 each month.
items.quote: Die Beiträge werden jeweils zum 15. des Folgemonats per Lastschrift eingezogen.

items.title: Objection deadline for contribution notice
items.action: If you disagree with the notice, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person with the insurer.
items.consequence: After the deadline the notice becomes final.

date.text: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe
